facts.business: KDDL Limited is a precision engineering company manufacturing watch components (dials, hands, indexes, bracelets), ornamental packaging, and high-precision stamped components (Eigen) for automotive, aerospace, and other industries, and operates luxury watch retail through its subsidiary Ethos Limited.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Installed capacity ~75,000 units per annum; 75% utilisation in 2025-26; additional floor planned for next phase
Additional facility ~30,000 sq. ft. in Bengaluru, expected operational in 2026-27
Commercial operations ramped up in 2025-26; capacity 1,00,000 units per month

guidance_or_targets.statement: Strategic priorities focused on capacity expansion, entry into adjacent product categories, and sharper focus on high-value, export-oriented segments

key_risks: Geopolitical volatility in the Middle East introducing supply-chain pressures and energy market volatility
Trade policy uncertainty and slowing merchandise trade growth (WTO projects 1.9% in 2026 vs 4.6% in 2025)
Global headline inflation projected to tick upward to 4.4% in 2026
Tariff issues and uncertain economic environment
Interest rate risk on floating rate borrowings
Foreign currency risk from unhedged exposures
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties were reviewed and approved by the Audit Committee, in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. No material significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Details disclosed per IND AS 24 in standalone financial statements and Regulation 23 filings on company website.
